scope: Three matched-camera views of unchanged original JK and converted MotS multiplayer maps, using the same private diagnostic engine based on production04. These are native game framebuffer screenshots; no AI generation, desktop capture, image editing, resizing or shader changes.
camera_method: Authored multiplayer spawn 0 orientation/sector, position plus 0.04 Z; both orient and lookPos assigned; camera only, player/map unchanged. Profile vertical FOV 90; actual engine horizontal FOV recorded per capture. Native scene FBO includes the native weapon model, excludes HUD overlay.
limits: Original JK means original archive rendered in OpenJKDF2 JK mode, not the native retail executable.
One static view per map; no exhaustive geometry/material/traversal validation.
Native starting weapons differ: JK Bryar pistol versus MotS green saber. Loadouts are not matched.
Captures occur about seven seconds into gameplay; animation and weather phases are not synchronized to the exact game tick.
Door/elevator behavior is a separate diagnostic test; these unchanged-map images contain no action fixture.

pairs.observation: The canyon walls, floor, walkway, bridge and cloudy sky are present with matching geometry in this view. No obvious missing visible geometry or replacement texture was observed; this conclusion is limited to the pictured view.
